== English Virtual Original comparison ==
Early imposes the additional 1 Force-or-out-of-play in opponent’s draw phase. Later explicitly adds a maintenance cost after the owner's Used Pile recirculates at end of turn. The default sacrifice still places the card out of play. The qualifying maintenance target, 1-Force opponent loss, optional 1-Force retrieval, power -3, battle-destiny ability exclusion and Control immunity agree. The native CardMaker face contains an extra purple subtype-row graphic absent from the issuer PDF, exact issuer-hosted 2007 image and underlying Special Edition print. Treat that as an art discrepancy.
